issues.detail: The Vietnamese 'do chức vụ chúng tôi phục vụ' (served by our ministry/service) incorrectly translates the Greek 'διακονηθεισα υφ ημων' (ministered/written by us). The Greek indicates that the believers are the letters *written by us* (the apostles), not that the letters were 'served by our ministry'.

The Vietnamese 'bảng thịt của lòng' (fleshly tablets of the heart) reverses/misplaces the Greek 'πλαξιν καρδιας σαρκιναις'. The Greek refers to 'tablets of human hearts' (hearts of flesh), not 'fleshly tablets of the heart'.
